Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From James Coupe <ja...@zephyr.org.uk> =====
>Reyda <re...@noos.fr> writes
>>Vamp Adam plays Superior Majesty. (but decides not to burn blood yet)
>>Can Vamp Betty play Thelepatic tracking right now ?
>
>No, Betty must wait for S:CE to resolve.

Correct.

>>Can Vamp Betty play a strike to cycle,
>
>Yes. Both vamps can choose strikes. S:CE does not resolve immediately
>upon being played, it resolves very first in the Resolution phase.
>
>>then play TT ?
>
>TT can only be played as combat is about to end.

Correct.

>>-Is damage from retainers / carrion crow inflicted on opposing vampire,since
>>combat does not end ? (i think not)
>
>No. Strike: Combat Ends resolves.
>Combat *almost* ends.
>A new round is started.
>
>We do not pass via Normal Strike or Press etc. Retainers resolve in
>Normal Strike. (There are no retainers currently which do not.)
>
>>-or do we "jump" directly to the next round ? (i guess so)
>
>Yes.

Correct.

>>-can Adam decide to untap by burning a blood then , after or before TT is
>>played ? (i'd bet on "before")
>
>It would have to be before, since he can pay for it when Majesty
>resolves. Once Majesty has resolved, Telepathic Tracking can be played
>to stop combat ending.
>
>See [LSJ 2001-02-21] "LSJ timing question"

Correct.

>>-is it possible to play multiple weather control,
>
>Yes. Weather Control can stack.

Correct.

>>then if opponent ends
>>combat, play TT
>
>Yes.
>
>> then Taste of Vitae (mm ?)
>
>No. As part of Telepathic Tracking's resolution:
>
> "Combat does not end; another round starts."
>
>The next round has started, hence we are now *not* after Strike
>Resolution (we're in a new round). The damage done by Weather Control
>in the first round is lost, so far as Taste of Vitae is concerned.

Correct.
